scope: Exactly three source roots. Generated artifacts, suppression configuration and unrelated concurrent edits left unchanged.

rootCauses.name: Google Form schema frozen at mount
rootCauses.impact: Functional correctness risk when updated form data arrives without unmounting: fields and submission target could remain stale. No evidence of an actual incorrect submission in production.
rootCauses.fix: Read current content.form_data directly; preserve module-scope dynamic import and child identity without a key or state reset.
rootCauses.tests: Regression failed before fix and passes afterward. Updated title/action propagate; existing input DOM, typed value and focus survive.

rootCauses.name: Repeated initial drawer-path lookup
rootCauses.impact: Minor wasted work on rerenders, with no known visible failure.
rootCauses.fix: Use a pure lazy useState initializer. Mount-only semantics are intentional: later content/path updates must not override user toggles.
rootCauses.tests: Regression failed before fix and passes afterward; initial path lookup runs once, later rerenders do not repeat it or reset the closed state. Existing icon identity tests pass. Strict Mode may independently invoke pure initialization twice.

rootCauses.name: Drawer-toggle branching complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk: interleaving drawer selection with custom/icon rendering made behavior changes harder to review. No known user-facing failure or claimed speedup.
rootCauses.fix: Extract module-scope DrawerToggleControl with explicit content, breakpoint, selected open state and handler; retain provider/store ownership and missing-right-drawer guard in parent.
rootCauses.tests: Five tests pass before and after refactor: both drawer directions, custom control clicks, force-show and breakpoint classes, icon identity/open-close transitions and missing right drawer.

recipeReview: Fetched all three recipes via curl with Cache-Control: no-cache and Pragma: no-cache. Checked intentional initial-state exceptions, pure lazy initialization and meaningful responsibility extraction. Read installed Next lazy-loading documentation before editing. Player playing state remains untouched because hover interactions own it after initialization.
